repairs.message: fix: retain authoritative metadata for protected recovery

edits.old: Text = "The archive tracks native provider identities and remains valid if media moves. Additional libraries are scan-only; existing media and sidecars are never renamed, moved, or rewritten.",
edits.new: Text = "History is path-agnostic. Existing libraries are scan-only and never modified. New protected downloads keep a .info.json identity sidecar so provider + ID can be rebuilt after archive loss.",
